title: Väddö tungsten fragment from 1957 car stop

tellings.quote:
In 1957, two carpenters were driving
their car in the middle of the night
really because they were doing some work
on Monday. This was Sunday and suddenly
they saw this object coming from east
moving in front of the car making a
Uturn and suddenly hanging in front of
the car which was totally died.

plain: In 1957 two carpenters were driving through the night near Väddö, northeast of Stockholm, when an object came in from the east, made a U-turn and hung in front of their car, and the car died completely. The Swedish researcher Clas Svahn tells Michels this without naming a source. The case is tied to a tungsten fragment, which would make it a rare encounter that left something physical behind.
